info.title: Villsource BuzMag API
info.description: The FSH Starter Kit API for Modular/Multitenant Architecture.

get.summary: Get all default organization unit from default organization.
Get all organization unit from default organization.

post.summary: Move an organization unit to new organization.

get.summary: Get all positions from default organization.
Get all positions from specified organization.
Get a position by reference id.

post.summary: Issue JWT access and refresh tokens
post.description: Submit credentials to receive a JWT access token and a refresh token. Provide the 'tenant' header to select the tenant context (defaults to 'root'). The 'X-FSH-App' header (admin|dashboard) is used to enforce the SuperAdmin / dashboard boundary.

post.summary: Refresh JWT access and refresh tokens
post.description: Use a valid (possibly expired) access token together with a valid refresh token to obtain a new access token and a rotated refresh token.

get.description: Retrieve roles available for the current tenant. Pageable via PageNumber/PageSize; filterable via Search (case-insensitive substring against name + description).

post.description: Create a new role or update an existing role's name and description.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific role by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Remove an existing role by its unique identifier.

get.description: Retrieve a role along with its assigned permissions.

put.description: Replace the set of permissions assigned to a role.

get.description: Returns every permission registered in the host, filtered to the caller's tenant context. Non-root tenants see the Admin set; the root tenant additionally sees the platform Root set.

post.description: Assign one or more roles to a user.

get.description: Retrieve the roles assigned to a specific user.

post.description: Change the current user's password.
Marks another user's email address as confirmed without a confirmation token.
Re-sends the email-confirmation link to a user who has not confirmed their address yet.

get.description: Confirm a user's email address.

delete.description: Delete a user by unique identifier.

get.description: Retrieve a user's profile details by unique user identifier.

patch.description: Activate or deactivate a user account.

get.description: Retrieve permissions for the authenticated user. Requires authentication only — every signed-in user can read their own grants.
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile from the access token.

put.description: Update profile details for the authenticated user. Any signed-in user may edit their own profile; no admin permission required.

get.description: Retrieve a list of users for the current tenant.
Search and filter users with server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering by status, email confirmation, and role.

post.description: Create a new user account.
Generate a password reset token and send it via email.
Reset the user's password using the provided verification token.
Allow a user to self-register. Anonymous; tenant identified via the tenant header.

put.summary: Set the authenticated user's avatar URL
put.description: Persists a durable image URL on the current user's profile. Typically called after the Files module's presigned-upload flow returns a publicUrl. Pass a null/empty body to clear.

get.description: Retrieve all active sessions for the currently authenticated user.

delete.description: Revoke a specific session for the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Revoke all sessions for the currently authenticated user except the current one.

get.summary: List all sessions in the current tenant (Admin)
get.description: Returns paged sessions across the tenant, filterable by active state and a free-text search across user name, email, and IP address.
Retrieve all active sessions for a specific user. Requires admin permission.

delete.description: Revoke a specific session for a user. Requires admin permission.

post.description: Revoke all sessions for a specific user. Requires admin permission.

get.description: Retrieve all groups for the current tenant with optional search filter.

post.description: Create a new group with optional role assignments.

get.description: Retrieve a specific group by its ID including roles and member count.

put.description: Update a group's name, description, default status, and role assignments.

delete.description: Soft delete a group. System groups cannot be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve all users that belong to a specific group.

post.description: Add one or more users to a group. Returns count of added users and list of users already in the group.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group
delete.description: Remove a specific user from a group.

get.description: Retrieve all groups that a specific user belongs to.

post.description: Issues a short-lived access token representing the target user. The token carries actor claims (act_sub, act_tenant) identifying the original caller. Platform operators (root tenant) may impersonate any user; tenant admins can only impersonate users within their own tenant. No refresh token is issued.
Returns a fresh access + refresh token for the original actor based on the act_sub/act_tenant claims embedded in the impersonation token. Callable by any authenticated impersonation session.

get.description: Lists impersonation sessions scoped to what the caller can see. Tenant admins are limited to grants targeting their own tenant; root operators can filter by any tenant.

post.description: Marks the grant as revoked. Subsequent requests carrying the impersonation token are rejected by the JWT validation hook within ~1 second (cache TTL).
Generates (or rotates) the current user's authenticator shared secret and returns it plus an otpauth:// URI for QR rendering. 2FA is NOT enabled until the caller confirms with /2fa/verify.
Verifies the 6-digit code from the authenticator app. On success, 2FA is enabled and subsequent logins must include a code.

post.summary: Disable TOTP for the current user
post.description: Turns off 2FA after confirming the current password. Also rotates the authenticator secret so a re-enroll starts fresh.
Activate or deactivate a tenant in a single endpoint.

get.description: Retrieve tenants for the current environment with pagination and optional sorting.

post.description: Create a new tenant.
Extend a tenant's validity by one plan term, optionally switching plans, and issue the term invoice.
Set a tenant's validity to an explicit date with no invoice or renewal event — for comps, support extensions, or immediate expiry.

get.description: Retrieve status information for a tenant, including activation, validity, and basic metadata.
Returns plan, validity, and expiry/grace state for the authenticated tenant — used by the tenant dashboard to show plan info and expiry warnings.
Get latest provisioning status for a tenant.

post.description: Retry the provisioning workflow for a tenant.

get.description: Retrieve migration status for each tenant, including pending migrations and provider information.
Retrieve the theme settings for the current tenant, including colors, typography, and brand assets.

put.description: Update the theme settings for the current tenant, including colors, typography, and layout.

post.description: Reset the theme settings for the current tenant to the default values.

get.description: Retrieve audit events with pagination and filters.
Retrieve full details for a single audit event.

get.summary: Get audit events by correlation id
get.description: Retrieve audit events associated with a given correlation id.

get.summary: Get audit events by trace id
get.description: Retrieve audit events associated with a given trace id.
Retrieve security audit events such as login, logout, and permission denials.
Retrieve audit events related to exceptions.
Retrieve aggregate counts of audit events by type, severity, source, and tenant.

post.description: Ops endpoint wrapping IUsageReporter.CaptureForPeriodAsync. Idempotent: re-running for the same (tenant, period) returns existing snapshots unchanged. Used for retroactive billing, debugging, and re-runs after fixes.
